#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
LL ones[17];
int solve(LL n,int i){
  int t = i*(n/ones[i]);
  n%=ones[i];
  if(n==0) return t;
  return t + min(i+solve(ones[i]-n,i-1),solve(n,i-1));
}
int main(){
  ones[0] = 0;
  for(int i=1;i<17;++i) ones[i] = ones[i-1]*10+1;
  LL n;
  cin >> n;
  cout << solve(n,16) << endl;
  return 0;
}
